scope: Tomczak and Godfrey report approximately 2,500 km for the Gulf Stream proper as an open-ocean free jet downstream of Cape Hatteras toward the Newfoundland Rise/Grand Banks near 50°W. This excludes the Florida Current and North Atlantic Current; it is a textbook path-scale description, not a measured reference streamline. NOAA's glossary uses the same strict segment definition, while NASA and NOAA Coast Pilot sometimes use Gulf Stream more broadly.

scope: The research description spans roughly 27°S–40°S; the coastal path is longer than its north–south separation. That narrower usage conflicts with the broader 27°S–40°S derived floor, so the two numbers are displayed as source-specific scopes and neither is ranked as a common whole-current length.

scope: Approximate basin-wide eastward pathway from north of Papua New Guinea to the South American coast described in Grenier et al. (2011). The source's 14,000 km is a broad path estimate, not a traced instantaneous core or the length of the Atlantic or Indian Equatorial Undercurrent. vocabulary_definition.density_variable_note: Thresholds refer to the source's neutral-density variable gamma_n in its conventional reported units, not an absolute seawater mass density of 28 kg/m3.

terms.criterion_summary: Layers with neutral density gamma_n greater than 28.0 (source-reported kg/m3 scale) do not extend onto the shelf.
Water with neutral density gamma_n greater than 28.0 (source-reported kg/m3 scale) occupies the shelf, which stays relatively cold with convection and dense-water formation.
Water with neutral density gamma_n greater than 28.0 reaches the shelf without dense-water formation; shelf water exceeds 0.5 degrees Celsius at some shelf depth.

footprint_support.coordinate_reference_status: Longitude/latitude inferred from figure axes; source figure does not specify a geodetic datum. Decimal output precision does not imply survey accuracy.
footprint_support.method: Segment the single closed blue loop by three RGB thresholds; trace its outside pixel contour; linearly georeference from the manually read panel ticks; intersect the enclosed polygon with the coast-masked approximate OSW state shapes under 16 independent ±3-pixel axis-tick perturbations per threshold.
footprint_support.physical_limit: Dated 2-D instantaneous SSH contour proxy only. Axis-tick sensitivity can place part of this near-boundary contour in CARB, so whole-footprint CAMR containment is unresolved. This is not the material coherent-core curve, a 3-D ring volume, or a claim for August/October. Source JPEG quality, manual axis reading, line thickness, and schematic OSW state geometry limit precision.
